name: Market News API
summary: Remote MCP server for market headlines, Binance listing events and crypto snapshots, with free previews and x402 access to paid data.

agent_access.notes: Connect over Streamable HTTP. Preview and discovery are free. Paid latest-news data starts at 0.005 USDC per successful request via x402 on Base or Solana. Archived UTC dates have gaps and are enumerated at /health.
